body.name: Certified finite fallback
body.construction: \(\mathsf{Enum}(n_B,n_S,R)\) enumerates every positive paired composition of totals \((2n_B,2n_S)\) up to common permutations, computes \([x^{n_B}y^{n_S}]\prod_\ell(1+x^{a_\ell}y^{b_\ell})\) by the recurrence \(d_{\ell+1}(i,j)=d_\ell(i,j)+d_\ell(i-a_{\ell+1},j-b_{\ell+1})\), and returns every feasible maximizer and its objective.
